event.Sink has no retry, delivery, or durability guarantee.
Go reference finalization runs AfterRun validation and repair before OnRunComplete, checkpoint projection, memory write, and the run.completed notification.
Go OnRunComplete receives a copy of the validated Result; mutating that copy does not rewrite the final result or run identity.

Go finalizes only middleware entered during startup, including a rejecting BeforeRun callback, and emits no run events on startup rejection. AfterRun errors do not prevent later entered callbacks from cleaning up; the first execution or finalization error remains primary.
A run.completed sink error is returned to the caller and OnRunError; Go does not attempt run.failed after attempting run.completed because some sinks may already have received completion.
Checkpoint projection, memory writes, and event delivery are not an atomic transaction.

eventTypes.when: A run enters the governed loop
A run returns an error, including policy or approval denial
A tool call is about to execute
A tool call is waiting for an approval decision
